protocol.name: conditional-historical-decision-replay-v1
protocol.status: New events reserved before ingestion; retrospective feed, conditional model, no causal reward
protocol.refinement_selection: first 12 central states in each event ordered by driver and lap
limitations: Fixed two-point tyre support is assumed, not physically identified
Fuel and track improvement is a declared sensitivity, not telemetry-estimated
Retrospective quality flags are not guaranteed available live
End-of-lap decision abstraction omits physical pit-entry commitment timing
Fresh same-baseline equivalent replacement, no measured compound offset, inventory or warm-up
Late-race optional-stop scope after two observed dry compounds; no wet-weather strategy
No counterfactual actual race reward or pit-lap imitation score
